title: 完整模型性能与输出审计

path_convention.audit_entry_path: Relative to the enclosing audit results_root.
path_convention.comparison_record_file: Relative to the case directory selected by model_id, sample_index, and kind.
path_convention.original_source_hashes: SHA-256 values apply to original file bytes. Embedded absolute paths are serialized relative to the repository root.

timing.averaging: Arithmetic mean of the two perf samples for each model.
timing.invoke_scope: CPU rdcycle difference around complete MicroInterpreter::Invoke; includes operator dispatch and execution, excludes initialization and post-Invoke output checking.
timing.initialization_scope: From before InitializeTarget through model and resolver setup, interpreter construction, AllocateTensors, input copy, and recording tensor metadata.
timing.planning_scope: Sum of measured dsa_schedule_cached_plan calls, including cache lookup and plan construction, recorded before Invoke.
timing.trace_use: Trace runs validate each operator output; their instrumentation cycles are excluded from performance means.
